mechanism: PIRS - Provenance-Invariant Referent Supervision. The referent target of a query becomes the quality of the hypothesis that query itself induces, t_i = IoU(sigmoid(mask_i), referred_instance_mask), computed for EVERY query, detached, with no seed-derived term. Architecture, query set, matcher, mask losses, score loss and contrastive term are unchanged, so no parameter is added and the forward graph is unchanged.

diagnosis.note: The defect is measured, not assumed: 783 of 824 native referent positives are already mask-OK while 2455 queries whose masks cover the referred instance are labelled no-object; the head scores .848 for seed+/mask- and .130 for seed-/mask+; 27.3% of expressions select an unacceptable query although an acceptable one exists; 118/123 have at least one acceptable query and the best acceptable rank is median 1.

derivation.note: Forward/loss derivation, gradient and degeneration cases, complexity, matched controls and pre-registered rejection criteria are stated in review1150 sections 6-7 and design1150 sections 3.1-3.4. Falsifiable predictions P1-P3 are fixed before training. Phase 1.6 smell check passed on all three criteria: new compute-graph dependence in the loss, no free hyperparameter introduced (g is fixed to identity), and cannot be described as adding one operator.

literature.note: RefMask3D (2407.18244v1, ACM MM 2024) re-read from the archived original PDF: Hungarian matching with cls+BCE+dice cost, then Lmatch = l_cls L_cls + l_bce L_bce + l_dice L_dice on the matched object, plus contrastive. One-to-one matching changes WHICH query is positive and leaves every other query, including the 2455 mask-OK duplicates, supervised as no-object, so it does not remove the measured contradiction. DETR-style set prediction, IoU/quality-aware 2D classification, set/cardinality losses and mask-aware contrastive alignment are each distinguished in design1150 section 3.3.

controls.note: Three controls bound the mechanism. (1) The matched control is the frozen M95 configuration itself (same protocol, 69.1% TRAIN selection success). (2) The objectness-only control is exactly null (69.1% -> 69.1%), so a mechanism that merely prefers queries whose seed lies inside some object cannot claim this gain; PIRS supplies referent identity, not objectness. (3) The nonlinear scene-grouped readout control tops out at 59-65% against the 87.0% oracle restriction, foreclosing readout-only explanations.

native_backward.note: Forward+backward on 3 real TRAIN batches, server6 GPU7, seed1999. The config basename resolves to the PIRS package; the reference checkpoint loads strict with 0 missing and 0 unexpected keys, confirming no parameter was added. Loss finite on every batch; 642 parameters receive gradient, 205 remain frozen (text encoder), 0 parameters have non-finite gradient. The referent-only path (all other entries of the criterion loss_weight zeroed) produces finite non-zero L1 gradient on every indi_embedding parameter across all six decoder layers, so the new supervision demonstrably drives the referent head.

resources.note: Measured one config per process with the historical instrument (fvcore FlopCountAnalysis plus bs=1 warmup20/repeat100 and peak allocated memory), because every variant package registers 'Criterion' into the same gorilla registry and two variants cannot be imported in one process. Parent: params 157484090, 10.20585054 G, peak 917.3671875 MiB. PIRS: identical to the last bit on all three, delta exactly 0. Latency differed 75.83 -> 88.05 ms median between two separate processes; for a bitwise-identical forward graph that is run-to-run noise and is recorded as such, not as a mechanism cost. Honest limitation: under this instrument the absolute value for the PARENT is 10.21 G, above the 10.0 G clause, while the historical audit recorded 9.762532428 G for the same parent, so this instrument is not the historical counter; per the constraint an instrument that would fail the champion cannot be used to reject a candidate, and the compliant readings are the paired delta of 0 plus the historical counter. Limitation: this check does not separately re-audit the full BCCA cost, since PIRS reproduces the M95 architecture exactly. No BCCA-style attribution is made for this candidate.

independence.note: Phase 3a checks: the model package physically exists with 7 files; no cross-variant import of Quard_model.<other> and no import of model_base1 anywhere in it; the config basename is globally unique (no duplicate basename across the config tree); resolve_network(config) was asserted at runtime to return the PIRS package's own Network class, so the config cannot silently fall back to another variant.

constraints.note: Checked against goal.json after the user's scope decision B. Phase 1 no-tuning: honoured, no sweep, no schedule change, epochs 50 and max_iters 70 unchanged, seed 1999 unchanged, g fixed to identity with no free value. Bans: none of the 11 applies - no gate, no language routing, no attnpool/qcond/agg/multi, no pruning, no nomask expansion, no repeated 3/4/6-layer injection, no large Q/K/V/O projection, no parameter sweep, and the variant is not 'a single added operator' because nothing is added. The 2026-09-10 validation boundary: overall metric plus the pre-defined strata and scene-level uncertainty are required at analysis time and the predictions are pre-registered. No new dataset or annotation. Resource clause: paired delta 0. Scope decision constraint 15: the axis is open, and this candidate is not presented as RefMask3D/DETR - the whole-mechanism difference is stated in the literature gate.
